verdict.rationale: Inside the product, Honeybadger offers a "Describe your search" panel that turns a natural-language description into an error search. It also offers anomaly detection that learns a baseline and reports unusual error rates (e.g. "4.7× your normal rate"). Neither is explicitly documented as AI-generated insights or suggestions about the data. The MCP server delivers analysis through an external AI assistant, not inside the product, so it earns no credit here. missing for 10: explicit in-product AI-generated insights or suggestions (e.g. AI error summaries, root-cause or fix suggestions), confirmation that natural-language search is AI-powered, hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: You can search for errors without writing the query yourself. Click the lightbulb icon next to the search box to open the “Describe your search” panel, then describe what you want to find.
Anomaly detection alerts you when a project’s total error volume deviates from its learned baseline
